coaching.headline: Too little return from the fights.
coaching.team: The enemy won most recorded fight sequences and took towers while we took none. The deaths before Fangtooth and the later tower loss deserve more attention than chasing a different shopping list.

focus.title: Set the contest condition
focus.action: Before the next Fangtooth setup, agree what must be ready to contest and what makes the team back off.

perPlayer.9681844e-07b6-4b92-8247-00a5a393b35a: Gadget led the team's damage and kept farming near the usual baseline. Keep that foundation, but do not wave away the death before Fangtooth because the damage total looks good. Review whether a safer position or earlier retreat was available and take the answer into the next setup.
perPlayer.8cc8b136-b5f5-4d0b-be88-2a425b3927e3: Aurora's economy never got going, and no completed item is a serious problem. Find where the income stopped, including farm access and downtime, before arguing about the build. Fix the income bottleneck first; a different shopping list cannot spend gold that never arrived.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock led ward placement, but farm and survival were rough. Keep the warding and prioritize reachable waves between fights. Review the death around the tower loss for a concrete correction. The gun needs gold, not a fucking sympathy card.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Yin delivered the team's strongest kill and objective output. Keep that pressure. Review whether a safer approach was available before Fangtooth, then carry any clear correction into the next setup.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel supplied the mitigation, but vision placement was sparse. Keep the frontline contribution and put wards on safe objective approaches before the next setup. Judge the coverage, not just the count. Dying to place a cosmetic ward is not an improvement.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ability.what: Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.

loadout.name: Forage

loadout.plain: After a dash, leap or teleport, you attack faster for 4s. Heaven's Fury's final teleport sets it up so you hit hard right after landing.

loadout.name: Quickdraw
loadout.text: Revenant reloads 35% faster and jumps 25% higher.
loadout.plain: Revenant reloads 35% faster after every four shots or when you reload with Hellfire Rounds. Less downtime between crit rounds means steadier damage, and the higher jump helps reposition.

loadout.name: Lotus
loadout.text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
numbers: 18 random bonuses this game (every 2 min plus 9 takedowns), 1 in 4 each: about +4.5% damage, about +18 ability haste, about +3.4% move speed, about +5.6% max health (expected)
loadout.plain: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for his kit.

loadout.name: Early Bloom
loadout.text: Gain an additional Level upon reaching Level 12.
loadout.plain: An extra level when you reach level 12. It gets Reckoning's next rank sooner; otherwise a generic boost.

loadout.name: Prima Donna
loadout.text: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.
loadout.plain: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick that only works if your team keeps divers off you.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 18 minutes, fewer deaths than about 91% of Revenant carry players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Revenant touched shortened Reckoning, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 105.9s late); fight right after Reckoning is spent.
Reckoning at rank 2: 125s base, about 105.9s by the end (15% shorter) from 18 ability haste: Lotus 18.
9 takedowns (4 kills, 5 assists) fed: Solstice (Pendulum), Lotus (Eternal).
Revenant dealt 16,540 hero damage, 35% of their team's, with +117 physical power from items.
Solstice (item): On Basic Attack: Consume all Pendulum stacks. Deal 10 Damage. Increased by (+0-50%), based on stacks consumed. Damage is increased by 2x at Max stacks.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Solstice: On Basic Attack: Consume all Pendulum stacks. Deal 10 Damage. Increased by (+0-50%), based on stacks consumed. Damage is increased by 2x at Max stacks.; 2,884 healing recorded.
Toughness: +30 physical armor, +30 magical armor; took 10,802 damage, mitigated 7,536, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Quickdraw: Revenant reloads 35% faster after every four shots or when you reload with Hellfire Rounds. Less downtime between crit rounds means steadier damage, and the higher jump helps reposition. (game text: Revenant reloads 35% faster and jumps 25% higher.) Field: 52.4% in 3352 games, 30% of picks, above the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout Eternal Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for his kit. (game text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.) [18 random bonuses this game (every 2 min plus 9 takedowns), 1 in 4 each: about +4.5% damage, about +18 ability haste, about +3.4% move speed, about +5.6% max health (expected)] Field: 54.4% in 1517 games, 14% of picks, above the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout minor Early Bloom: An extra level when you reach level 12. It gets Reckoning's next rank sooner; otherwise a generic boost. (game text: Gain an additional Level upon reaching Level 12.) Field: 55.9% in 556 games, 37% of picks, above the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout minor Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick that only works if your team keeps divers off you. (game text: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.) Field: 57.1% in 823 games, 54% of picks, above the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout crest Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on a target below 20% health. Dash and fire your final round to execute, and a kill lets you recast it. (game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.4% in 6733 games, 60% of picks, above the hero-role's 51%.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Solstice, Pacifier, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Solstice, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Solstice, Pacifier.

The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; every takedown fed), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 1 of the 2 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Steel). No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Revenant 1 time.
Copy it? Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna): 60.9% in 261 Revenant carry games, above the hero's 51%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
